moments.title: Great British Bake Off returns with new judge
moments.blurb: The 17th series of The Great British Bake Off begins tonight, Tuesday 22nd September, with Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood as a new judge.

angles.name: Bake Off is BACK!
angles.copy: The tent is open! Great British Bake Off Series 17 kicks off tonight with Alison Hammond, Noel Fielding, Paul Hollywood and new judge Nigella Lawson. Who's watching? #GBBO

angles.name: Nigella in the tent
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson in the Bake Off tent... it just feels right, doesn't it? Catch her debut as a judge tonight on Channel 4!

moments.title: Premier League Matchday 5 results
moments.blurb: Manchester City maintained their perfect start with a 5-3 win over Sunderland, while Arsenal's unbeaten run ended with a 3-0 defeat to Brighton in Matchday 5 games played September 18-20.

angles.name: City's perfect start
angles.copy: Five games, five wins for Man City! They're still perfect after Matchday 5, but Arsenal's unbeaten run is over. What a weekend of Premier League action! #PremierLeague

angles.name: Surprise results
angles.copy: Brighton thrashing Arsenal, Brentford beating Chelsea... Matchday 5 of the Premier League had some shockers! Did your team deliver? #Football

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing first live show
moments.blurb: The first live show of Strictly Come Dancing 2026 airs this Saturday, September 26, after the celebrity pairings were revealed in the launch show.

angles.name: Strictly live this week
angles.copy: The glitterball officially starts spinning this Saturday! The first Strictly Come Dancing live show is on BBC One – who are you backing? #Strictly

angles.name: New hosts & pairings
angles.copy: New hosts, new pairings, new routines! Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe and Johannes Radebe lead the way as Strictly goes live this weekend. Get ready for the dances! #StrictlyComeDancing

moments.title: Gallagher Premiership Rugby kicks off
moments.blurb: Round 1 of the Gallagher Premiership Rugby season begins this Friday, September 25, with Northampton Saints starting their title defence against Newcastle Red Bulls.

angles.name: Premiership Rugby is back!
angles.copy: It's kick-off time for Gallagher Premiership Rugby this Friday! Northampton Saints begin their title defence. Who's ready for the new season? #GallagherPrem

angles.name: Exeter Chiefs first game
angles.copy: Huge weekend for the Chiefs! Exeter Chiefs kick off their Gallagher Premiership campaign at home against Gloucester this Saturday, September 26. Good luck, lads! #ExeterChiefs

moments.title: Red Roses host New Zealand in WXV Global Series
moments.blurb: England's Red Roses take on New Zealand in the WXV Global Series at Allianz Stadium, Twickenham, this Saturday, September 26.

angles.name: Red Roses home game
angles.copy: Huge clash this Saturday! The Red Roses face New Zealand at Twickenham in the WXV Global Series. Get behind the team! #RedRoses

angles.name: Big weekend for women's rugby
angles.copy: It's a massive weekend for women's rugby as England's Red Roses host New Zealand. Who's excited for this international showdown? #WomensRugby
